name: The British Club
summary: Bukit Timah membership club with sport, dining, and family programming — a Commonwealth-orbit alternative to Orchard mega-clubs.
body: The British Club sits in the Bukit Timah club belt with dining, sport, and family events that appeal to British and wider international households. It is facilities-first compared with the British Association’s lighter social calendar — compare both before paying entrance fees. Useful when school and housing already sit west/central and you want weekend camps or pool access without Claymore traffic. Confirm current membership categories, F&B minimums, and waitlists; tour at your real use times. Pair with BritCham only if BD is the goal, and with British Association for lower-fee soft landing. Junior holiday weeks and family sport calendars are a membership-tier coverage option when both parents work through school breaks — see school-holiday coverage for dual-career ops.
membershipNotes: Entrance fees + monthly dues; ask about family categories, guest rules, and school-break programmes.
